issues.description: Method signature mismatch for the private helper singFarmSongVerse: the template declares singFarmSongVerse without an Animal parameter (signature at src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java line 18: private void singFarmSongVerse(/*Animal animal*/)), while the problem statement UML and the reference solution declare singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal) (problem_statement.md line 19 and solution src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java line 33). This difference can confuse students implementing singFarmSong() because the intended helper is expected to accept an Animal argument so each verse can be produced for a specific animal.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template helper match the specification and solution: change the template signature to private void singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal) and update the template implementation so the public singFarmSong() iterates over the Farm's animals and calls singFarmSongVerse(animal) for each. This aligns the template with the UML and reference implementation and prevents student confusion about how to produce per-animal verses.
